# Jacob Goldring

> Full stack engineer and co-founder. Builds banking apps for credit unions by
> day and is the co-founder and CTO of Vamo, a startup for local markets.

## About

Jacob Goldring writes mobile apps, the APIs behind them and the data layer
underneath. His day job is a white-label digital banking platform for credit
unions, where one codebase ships as a separately themed and separately
configured product for each credit union. He is also backup on production
mobile devops.

He is co-founder and CTO of Vamo, which started as a street food discovery app
and grew into a platform for night markets, farmers markets and pop-ups. It is two
apps and a website on one backend: the Vamo app for shoppers and vendors, Vamo
Host for the hosts who run the markets, and a website for both. A host opens
spaces in Vamo Host, vendors apply and pay for them in Vamo, and shoppers find
the market, its vendors and its map in Vamo.

The Vamo app is live on the App Store and Google Play, with about 200 vendors.
Vamo Host is on Google Play, with iOS coming soon. Two hosts are live, with
their first markets in November 2026.

Vamo is a two-person company based in Southern California. Jacob and his
business partner both do a lot of everything. Jacob also handles mobile DevOps,
SDK and package upgrades and security checks, and works to keep the codebase
maintainable and well tested.

## Stack

Mobile: React Native, Expo, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, React Native Web
Web: Next.js, React, Vue, Tailwind
API: C#, .NET, Entity Framework, Dapper, Azure, Docker
Data: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Supabase, MySQL
